title: Axisymmetry of Spherical Near-Horizon Geometries
exact_target: Must every spherical solution of the indicated near-horizon equations have rotational symmetry and come from extremal Kerr?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003909 (OWR-16411-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical General Relativity (2018), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2018/36, pp. 2157--2251. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 18.
Chrusciel--Szybka--Tod 2018 (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The actual vacuum equation was recovered from PDF page 18. The report establishes local rigidity near Kerr and states the global removal-of-axisymmetry conjecture; modern status is not freshly established here. The problem is not enlarged to matter or nonzero cosmological constant.
